title: zuroar 0.0.0.9000
text: New package: compressed sets unsigned integers built bundled copy CRoaring 5.4.0. development towards first CRAN release. zuroar_info() reports bundled CRoaring version, SIMD paths compiled , instruction sets processor offers. roar() roar_range() build 32-bit bitmap; roar_add() roar_remove() return changed copy, sharing unchanged containers; roar_contains() tests membership. bitmap behaves sorted vector length(), min(), max(), range(), .integer(), .double(), format() print(). Errors inherit zuroar_error, zuroar_error_value, zuroar_error_pointer, zuroar_error_unsupported zuroar_error_memory specific cases. Set algebra: |, &, roar_xor(), roar_andnot(), roar_union(), roar_intersect() c() build bitmaps; ==, !=, <=, <, >= > compare sets; roar_cardinality(), roar_jaccard(), roar_intersects() roar_disjoint() answer without building one. roar_flip() flips range. x + k, x - k roar_shift() shift every value; leaving domain error unless roar_shift(drop = TRUE).
